title: On the Stability Connection Between Discrete-Time Algorithms and Their Resolution ODEs: Applications to Min-Max Optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2603.01430v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We establish a connection between the stability of discrete-time algorithms (DTAs) and continuous-time dynamical systems, in particular their $O(s^r)$-resolution ordinary differential equations (ODEs). We show that exponential stability of a common equilibrium transfers to the DTA whenever the one-step error is small relative to the distance to the equilibrium and the one-step Lyapunov decay. This condition is sharp in order, and one-step consistency alone is insufficient. The result is local and allows step-size-dependent ODEs and Lyapunov functions, covering $O(s)$-resolution ODEs whose decay rate vanishes as the step size tends to zero. Asymptotic stability is not inherited in general, but a comparison criterion and a checkable compatibility condition ensure it carries over for equilibria and compact sets. translated_title: 论离散时间算法与其分辨率常微分方程之间的稳定性联系：在极小极大优化中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们建立了离散时间算法（DTAs）的稳定性与连续时间动力系统之间的联系，特别是其 $O(s^r)$-分辨率常微分方程（ODEs）。我们证明，当单步误差相对于到平衡点的距离以及单步 Lyapunov 衰减量足够小时，公共平衡点的指数稳定性可以传递到离散时间算法。该条件在阶数上是紧的，仅有单步一致性是不够的。该结果是局部的，并且允许使用与步长相关的 ODE 和 Lyapunov 函数，从而涵盖衰减率随步长趋于零而消失的 $O(s)$-分辨率 ODE。渐近稳定性在一般情况下并不能被继承，但借助一个比较准则和一个可检验的相容性条件，可以确保其对于平衡点和紧集仍然成立。对于分辨率 ODE 而言，更新映射的联合正则性保证了所需的误差界。我们将该框架应用于极小极大优化……
tldr: 本文建立了离散时间算法与其 O(s^r)-分辨率常微分方程之间的稳定性传递理论，给出了指数稳定性从 ODE 传递到离散算法的紧条件，并应用于极小极大优化。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a stability transfer theory between discrete-time algorithms and their O(s^r)-resolution ODEs, providing a sharp condition under which exponential stability carries over from the ODE to the discrete algorithm, with applications to min-max optimisation.
